giveOne.label: Our Donation Model
giveOne.title: From One Woman to Another
giveOne.body: For every order, you can choose to add a pad or tampon box at a reduced price. It will not come to you, it goes directly to a woman who needs it, through our partner organisations in the Netherlands and Germany. No admin, no middleman. Just one woman helping another.
giveOne.donatedToWoman: Donated to a woman in need
giveOne.footnote: Partner organisations in the Netherlands and Germany announced at launch. Every donated box goes directly to women in need.
giveOne.interBody: Add a box at cost price and we deliver it to a woman who needs it, through our partner organisations. No admin, no middleman.
